verdict.rationale: Highnote is a payments SaaS that holds sensitive customer and transaction data, so a buyer could reasonably ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. The axis applies, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, a data-use opt-out, or a no-training commitment. The PCI, iframe-isolation and role-permission items cover data security and access control, not training use, so they cannot be credited.
